en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European settlement at the base of terraced hillsides. In the foreground are orchards and a road bordered by a stone wall; behind it stand several large, manor‑like houses with steep, tiled roofs and dormer windows. One building has a small tower with a spire resembling a chapel or clock tower. Further back, more villas and institutional buildings sit among bare trees on the lower slopes. The hills behind are patterned with terraces and paths, likely vineyards, and are mostly leafless, suggesting late autumn or winter. No printed title or legible writing is visible on the image.
